metadata.title: When 2 accidental kills make me question if I’m actually good or just lucky
metadata.description:
Didn’t mean to hit those shots but here we are.
Enemy probably uninstalling to rethink their life choices.
Click if your aim’s a mess but the game still throws you freebies.
Watch me pretend this was all skill for a sec.

Tap if your luck’s better than your aim!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
